specific_polish_requirements.requirement: Functional keyword search filtering live auctions/items, with clear 'No results found.' message and option to clear filter when empty.
Rename label 'Collectibles' to 'NFT' and remove any disclaimers associated with Collectibles.

Hide Condition field when NFT auction type is selected, while retaining Condition input for non-NFT auction types. Remove user-facing Anti-Sniping Window input field while preserving internal automatic +10s extension.
Clean up Profile labels and text exact copy.
Fix responsive grid layout specifically at 360px and 390px viewport widths to avoid horizontal overflow or squished content.
Clean Wallet labels, subtitle, and warning box exact text.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: Mandatory on all interactive and key data display elements (buttons, inputs, status badges, tabs, cards, search input)
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_convention: kebab-case role-based format (e.g. search-input, auction-card-1, nft-tab-button)
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 WCAG AA text contrast against dark backgrounds.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Preserve BIDZONE's existing visual identity (dark charcoal near-black background, neon purple accents, Unbounded display font, glassmorphism cards).
Do not alter smart contracts, NFT ownership logic, ownerOf, safeTransferFrom, embedded wallet, database, backend, bidding, auction lifecycle, escrow, shipping, auth, admin, notifications, or RLS.
Add explicit data-testid attributes to all new or edited interactive elements.
Ensure header/navigation remains visible with proper backdrop blur and z-index (z-50).
